hooks.quest.start: Begin the referenced quest if it is not already active or complete.
hooks.quest.objective: Increment a quest objective by the supplied amount and update quest readiness.
hooks.quest.complete: Finalize quest rewards and completion state.
hooks.inventory.give: Grant the referenced item/count once when the event page permits it.
hooks.waystitch.activate: Unlock or open travel for the referenced Waystitch.
